name: Panda Express String Bean Chicken Breast
whyItWorks: Lean chicken breast strips and green beans wok-tossed in a mild ginger-soy sauce. Unlike Orange Chicken or Beijing Beef, the chicken is completely un-breaded and not deep-fried.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Bowl with Steamed White Rice and String Bean Chicken Breast. Chew string beans thoroughly.
